meta.name: provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪系统的每一步操作，留作可审计的证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在维护多智能体系统，需要完整操作日志做安全审计
copy.tagline_en: Trace every operation across your system to build an auditable evidence chain
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a multi-agent system and need full operation logs for security audit

howto.what: 它会按统一结构记录系统各环节的操作事件；向量库写入失败时先缓存在本地 SQLite，恢复后异步补写。输出按 trace_id 串联的证据链、向量索引条目，以及按 trace_id、时间窗或官署维度检索历史的查询接口。
howto.when: 在分发、扫描、解析等关键操作节点被调用，或由事件总线异步推送事件时触发；也可直接运行 run_provenance.py 生成示例留痕。

say.text: 查询 trace_id 为 t1 的完整证据链。
say.note: 返回该链路全部事件的串联结果。

say.text: 运行 run_provenance.py 生成留痕示例。

howto.what_en: Records operation events in a unified format. If vector-store writes fail, caches to SQLite and re-writes later. Outputs trace-linked evidence chain, vector index, and query API by trace_id, time range, or department.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a module reports an event or when an event is pushed over the bus (dispatch, scanning, parsing, etc.). It can also be invoked by running run_provenance.py.

say_en.text: Record a dispatch event: actor=dispatcher, action=dispatch, target=order, trace_id=t1.
say_en.note: Appends one chained record from these fields.

say_en.text: Query the full evidence chain for trace_id=t1.
say_en.note: Returns all events in that trace in order.

say_en.text: Run run_provenance.py to generate a trace sample.
